description: After adding or importing picks, fetch their enriched preview here. If preparing, wait briefly and call again. Render previewMarkdown: supplied artwork, title/byline, original note, short description and labeled links for every pick. Keep reviewId and itemRefs internal. Omit IDs, positions, confidence scores and provenance commentary. Ask once if it looks good. No app visit or later list update is needed. An unfinished preview survives reconnecting.
